rationale.complete: Round 1 plus round 1b: arm (a) re-run on the corrected activity table with the DQ8-calibrated null (trimmed block-shift edge; H38 stall mask instead of the lull filter); arm (b) and content modes re-run with the second embedding model and DQ5 statement flags; two period-native tests with ground truth (#12 motion on/off, #26 vote instants). Holdout not run; the frozen confirmatory C1-C3/C5 need re-freezing.
rationale.faithfulness: Mixed in both directions. HH77 loses its activity half: the market mode survives the calibrated null in 7/24 units and was largely a day-level artifact of the event-drop bug; talk (21/24) and content (24/24, model-robust) modes hold. HH58 fails at kickoffs (robust), but natively a strong uniform field compresses content (#12, PR -25%, p = 0.01, same sign in gte) and a contested vote does too (#26). C = 1 in both arms; E and G now 1 for the PR arm. Net unchanged at 1.5.
rationale.usefulness: A cheap restatement-rate monitor (either-model flag) that flags stuck agents, now robust across embedding models; a negative that matters for operators (activity co-activation is not a collective mode once schedule and data artifacts are removed); a field-compression effect that could become a 'strong-field' alarm, not yet validated beyond #12.

one_line: On corrected data the activity market mode is mostly artifact; talk and content modes are real, a strong field compresses content, kickoffs don't, and low-dimensional weeks are agents restating themselves.
